title: Optimistic concurrency conflict

checks.check: requested address with concurrent VIP update retained

final_response:
Done. Contact C-7's address is now "42 Pine Street".

What happened:
1. Fetched C-7 → version 1 (`name: Lina`, `address: Old road`, `vip: false`).
2. First patch with `expected_version: 1` returned `VERSION_CONFLICT` — a concurrent update had committed (`vip` changed to `true`).
3. Re-fetched (version 2) and reapplied only the address change with `expected_version: 2`.

Verified final record (version 3):
- `name`: Lina (unchanged)
- `address`: 42 Pine Street ✅
- `vip`: true (concurrent update preserved)

No other records or files were modified; no policy documents were present in the workspace.
